consequence.statement: The release note states only that cert-manager uses a local fork of the acme package; it describes no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: Cert-manager now uses a local fork of the golang.org/x/crypto/acme package; this is an internal dependency change with no stated operator impact.

decision.reason: [ev-4fcf47388827] says only that cert-manager now uses a local fork of the golang.org/x/crypto/acme package. The note sits under Features and names no operator-facing setting, API, flag, image or behaviour. Nothing in the surrounding section [ev-7be235e771a3] [ev-cf14b14073be] says that anything fails, is rejected or has to be migrated because of this change. A "none"/informational consequence claims no mandatory work, and nothing in the evidence contradicts it. Confidence is low because the release note doesn't state outright that there's no impact, and the PR (#7752) details aren't in the evidence.
